_comment: Fixed recap and message templates. Filled only from confirmed terms; no model text. The Hindi wording is a draft and has not been reviewed by a native speaker.

en.title: Summary of what we agreed
en.intro: Hi {other_name}, just confirming what we agreed so far:
en.intro_anon: Hi, just confirming what we agreed so far:

missing.friendly: {greeting} one thing we have not talked about yet: {label}. What works for you?
missing.neutral: {label} has not been discussed. Please tell me what you propose.
missing.firm: We still need to settle {label}. Please reply with your answer today so we are both clear.

unclear.friendly: {greeting} you mentioned "{quote}" for {label}. Could we fix an exact answer?
unclear.neutral: Regarding {label}: "{quote}" is not exact. Please confirm the exact details.
unclear.firm: "{quote}" for {label} is not specific enough. Please give the exact details so we can close this.

contradicted.friendly: {greeting} I see two different things for {label}: "{quote}" and "{quote2}". Which one is right?
contradicted.neutral: {label} is stated as "{quote}" and as "{quote2}". Please confirm which one applies.
contradicted.firm: {label} was said in two ways: "{quote}" and "{quote2}". Please confirm one answer today.

check.firm: Please confirm {label}: {value}, so we can record it.

review.friendly: {greeting} I read "{quote}" for {label}. Can you confirm that is right?
review.neutral: For {label} I have "{quote}". Please confirm that is correct.
review.firm: For {label} I have "{quote}". Please confirm it is correct so we can record it.

hi.title: हमने जो तय किया उसका सार
hi.intro: नमस्ते {other_name}, अब तक हमने यह तय किया है:
hi.intro_anon: नमस्ते, अब तक हमने यह तय किया है:
hi.none_confirmed: अभी कुछ पक्का नहीं हुआ है।

open.contradicted: {label}: दो अलग तरह से कहा गया है।

hi.reply_line: अगर सब सही है तो जवाब दें: CONFIRM {code}
hi.disclaimer: मसौदा बनाने में सहायता, कानूनी सलाह नहीं।

missing.friendly: {greeting} एक बात पर हमने अभी बात नहीं की: {label}। आपको क्या ठीक रहेगा?
missing.neutral: {label} पर बात नहीं हुई है। कृपया बताइए आपका क्या प्रस्ताव है।
missing.firm: {label} अभी तय होना बाकी है। कृपया आज ही अपना जवाब भेजें ताकि हम दोनों साफ़ रहें।

contradicted.firm: {label} दो तरह से कहा गया: "{quote}" और "{quote2}"। कृपया आज एक ही जवाब पक्का करें।
